text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Tetanus.

The history of a 3000g newborn born to a mother with no prenatal care and unavailable immunization records is highly suspicious for neonatal tetanus, often presenting with stiffness, trismus (lockjaw), or opisthotonos despite normal vital signs and blood counts. Please confirm if the baby exhibits muscle rigidity, difficulty feeding, or arching of the back.
